Title: Blazor String Parameters in event handlers in the new Preview 9, rc.
Description: ### Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.

Hi I just updated from AspNetCore 3.0 Preview 7 to AspNetCore 3.0 RC1 and there the event handler syntax changed significantly.

The old version was this:
onclick=@(async ()=> SetPagerSize("forward"))

I havent found something yet, but is there a way to pass strings as parameters.

There passing string parameters was possible 

How can I pass strings to functions in RC1?

<button class="btn pagebutton btn-secondary" @onclick="(async ()=> NavigateToPage("next"))">Next</button>


since the content of @onclick= needs to be inside "", the string "next" will end this string. Is there already a syntax to fix this? When I use '' like in javascript 

### Describe the solution you'd like
Not shure what would be the best soltion, now I extract all my strings to constants. In javascript you can always use '' inside the "", but that would violate the C# syntax.
